verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS connectivity platform that stores account, device, and access-log data, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents configurable retention periods, log or data deletion, or account data purging. Removing users (docs-13) and auto-removing ephemeral nodes (docs-39) are adjacent membership features, not data-retention controls, so they earn no credit.
